facts.end_use: subcomponent of a laser bar code scanner

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8501 covers electric motors; subheading depends on output in watts (8501.10 not exceeding 37.5 W vs 8501.31 etc.)

rejected_alternatives.reason: parts of machines of 8471 would require a motor to be principally a part of such machine; a motor is a complete electric motor of heading 8501 (and Sec XVI note 2 sends goods of 8501 there)

missing_facts: What is the rated output power of the motor in watts (under 18.65 W, 18.65-37.5 W, or higher)?
Is the motor a complete motor or only a part (e.g., rotor/stator only)?
classification.rationale: Heading 8501 covers electric motors; the 6-digit subheading turns on output power (8501.10 for not over 37.5 W, 8501.31 for DC motors over 37.5 W up to 750 W), which is not stated. Ruling H87929 (DC brushless motor, in force) is on similar goods but the power rating is needed.
